extension.description: Shows Cursor or Visual Studio Code activity as Discord Rich Presence.
config.title: Discord Presence
config.language: Language used for Rich Presence and status messages.
config.language.auto: Follow the Cursor or Visual Studio Code display language.
config.largeImageMode: Select the large image shown on Discord.
config.largeImageMode.editor: Show the Cursor or Visual Studio Code logo.
config.largeImageMode.languageText: Show the text-based language image, such as JS or JSON.
config.largeImageMode.languageTextEditor: Show filled language text with a small Cursor or Visual Studio Code logo embedded in the corner.
config.largeImageMode.languageOutline: Show the language name as stylized outlined text.
config.largeImageMode.languageOutlineEdi: Show stylized outlined text with a small Cursor or Visual Studio Code logo embedded in the corner.
config.largeImageMode.languageLogo: Show the programming language logo. Falls back to the text image when no logo is available.
config.privacyMode: Hide file and workspace names. Template variables are replaced with private labels.
config.showSmallEditorIcon: Show the Cursor or Visual Studio Code logo as Discord's native circular badge over the large image. Discord controls its size.
config.showWorkspace: Show the workspace name on Discord.
config.showFileName: Show the current file name on Discord.
config.showLanguage: Show the programming language. When disabled, the generic Code image is used.
config.customDetails: Custom Details text. Available variables: `{file}`, `{workspace}`, `{language}`, `{app}`. Leave empty to use the default.
config.customState: Custom State text. Available variables: `{file}`, `{workspace}`, `{language}`, `{app}`. Leave empty to use the default.
config.idleMessage: Message shown when no editor is active. Leave empty to use the selected language's default.
